disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置是否读取系统凭据文件（用户主目录凭据、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据等）或硬编码密钥：未发现相关代码路径，也未发现密钥字面量。
checked_items.en: Checked whether all source code and configuration read system credential files (user home credentials, SSH private keys, cloud vendor credentials, etc.) or hardcoded secrets: no related code paths were found, and no secret literals were found either.

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量处理逻辑：插件会把 Multica 下发的任务令牌（以 mat_ 开头、长度大于 4）透传给模型生成的子进程，为此对宿主的凭据清洗规则做了该变量名的单一豁免并带恢复逻辑；README 与单元测试均明确说明此行为，未发现插件自身读取该令牌后向外发送的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Checked environment variable handling logic: the plugin passes the task token issued by Multica (starting with mat_, length greater than 4) to the environment of the subprocess spawned by the model. To do this, it adds a single exemption for this variable name to the host's credential redaction rules, with recovery logic; the README and unit tests clearly document this behavior, and no code path was found in which the plugin itself reads the token and sends it outbound.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取系统凭据文件，自身代码无任何网络发送路径；唯一凭据相关行为是把任务令牌透传给子进程环境，属文档声明的功能，未形成外泄链。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read system credential files, and its own code has no network-sending paths; the only credential-related behavior is passing the task token into subprocess environments, which is a documented feature and does not form an exfiltration chain.

checked_items.zh: 通读了挂载配置中的系统提示词段：内容为 Multica 无头运行模式的角色设定（说明不调用交互提问、在最终回复中说明决策选项），未发现伪装系统消息、覆写既有指令、诱导读取凭据或诱导安装等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the system prompt section in the patch config: the content is the role definition for Multica's headless run mode (stating that interactive questioning is not invoked and that decision options are explained in the final reply). No wording was found that disguises system messages, overwrites existing instructions, induces credential reading, or induces installation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件源码的工具注册与提示词注入面：本插件未注册任何对外工具，未注入系统提示片段，仓库内无代理指令文件、技能说明等模型面指令文件。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin source code for tool registration and prompt injection surface: this plugin registers no external tools, injects no system prompt fragments, and the repository contains no proxy instruction files, skill descriptions, or other model-facing instruction files.

evidence.zh: 插件没有注册工具，系统提示词仅作无头模式角色说明，未检出工具描述投毒或提示词投毒文本。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, and the system prompt only serves as a headless-mode role description. No tool-description poisoning or prompt-injection text was detected.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册工具，提示词与说明文档中未出现诱导安装、诱导改写配置或诱导放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, and no wording was found in the prompt or documentation that induces installation, induces configuration rewriting, or induces permission escalation.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中挂载配置中的一处可执行表达式（规则 DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51，cordis.patch.yml 第 13 行）：该表达式把会话根目录解析为环境变量值与默认目录的取或，属配置取值而非任意代码；经核查表达式内无网络外联、无凭据访问、无破坏性载荷，判定为良性配置用法，不构成代码执行风险。
checked_items.en: Static scanning hit one executable expression in the patch config (rule DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51, line 13 of cordis.patch.yml): the expression resolves the session root directory as an OR of the environment variable value and the default directory. This is a configuration value lookup rather than arbitrary code; upon review, the expression contains no network outbound connections, no credential access, and no destructive payload. It is judged to be benign configuration usage and does not constitute a code execution risk.

checked_items.zh: 检查了危险函数调用面：源码中未发现动态代码求值、直接执行子进程命令、远程载荷下载即执行等调用；唯一的动态加载操作用于解析宿主已安装的同一官方依赖实例，属正常运行时操作。
checked_items.en: Checked the dangerous function call surface: no dynamic code evaluation, direct subprocess command execution, or remote-payload download-and-execute calls were found in the source code; the only dynamic load operation is used to resolve the same official dependency instance already installed on the host, which is a normal runtime operation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与构建脚本：包声明中没有安装钩子，没有下载即执行脚本；构建仅做类型检查与编译。
checked_items.en: Checked the install and build scripts: the package declaration contains no install hooks and no download-and-execute scripts; the build only performs type checking and compilation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置含一处可执行表达式（DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51 命中），但内容仅为会话目录的路径解析（环境变量或默认目录二选一），无恶意载荷，判定不构成通过配置执行任意代码的风险。
evidence.en: The patch config contains one executable expression (DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51 hit), but its content is only session directory path resolution (choosing between an environment variable or the default directory), with no malicious payload. It is judged not to constitute a risk of arbitrary code execution through configuration.

evidence.zh: 源码中未发现调用动态包定义/执行类工具，无让模型把代码塞进宿主执行的自修改能力面。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package definition/execution tools were found in the source code, and there is no self-modification capability surface that would let the model stuff code into host execution.

evidence.zh: 包声明中无安装钩子，仓库内也没有钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置、构建脚本等执行载体。
evidence.en: The package declaration contains no install hooks, and the repository contains no hook managers, CI workflows, container configurations, build scripts, or other execution carriers.

evidence.zh: 包未声明浏览器端模块，不存在自动加载的客户端代码面，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The package does not declare a browser-side module, so there is no automatically loaded client code surface; this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码的网络调用面：插件自身没有发起任何 HTTP 请求、WebSocket 或原始套接字连接；与父进程的通信走标准输入输出上的 JSONL 协议。
checked_items.en: Checked the network call surface of all source code: the plugin itself makes no HTTP requests, WebSocket connections, or raw socket connections; communication with the parent process uses the JSONL protocol over standard input/output.

checked_items.zh: 检查了对外连接配置的流向：外部模型与 MCP 服务的连接由宿主的官方客户端组件按父进程下发的配置建立，插件仅做参数透传，未发现隐蔽外发通道或编码外发链。
checked_items.en: Checked the flow of outbound connection configuration: connections to external models and MCP services are established by the host's official client components according to the configuration passed from the parent process. The plugin only transparently passes parameters. No covert exfiltration channels or encoded exfiltration chains were found.

checked_items.zh: 核对配置：挂载配置显式关闭了遥测上报，未发现其他外联域名或外发信标。
checked_items.en: Verified the configuration: the patch config explicitly disables telemetry reporting, and no other outbound domains or exfiltration beacons were found.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取系统凭据文件、自身无网络外发代码；唯一凭据相关行为是把任务令牌透传给子进程环境，属声明功能，未形成凭据外泄链。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read system credential files and has no network outbound code of its own; the only credential-related behavior is passing the task token into subprocess environments, which is a declared feature and does not form a credential exfiltration chain.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单与锁文件：全部依赖为官方 DeepSeek Harness 系列包与常见工具链，版本在锁文件中固定；未发现仿冒包名、拼写相似包或可疑来源。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list and lockfile: all dependencies are official DeepSeek Harness packages and common tooling, with versions pinned in the lockfile; no counterfeit package names, spelling-similar packages, or suspicious sources were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置对安全配置的覆盖：配置仅禁用了热重载与遥测、调整了会话目录与系统提示词，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，未发现通过配置降权的写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config coverage of security settings: the config only disables hot reload and telemetry and adjusts the session directory and system prompt; it does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions. No wording was found that downgrades security through configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查审批事件处理：插件注册了自动放行审批的监听器（返回单次允许），与其无头运行模式的设计说明一致，属明确声明的行为而非隐蔽绕过。
checked_items.en: Checked approval event handling: the plugin registers an auto-approve listener (returning a one-time allow), which is consistent with its headless-mode design description and is an explicitly declared behavior rather than a covert bypass.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无历史版本基线，无法进行版本间变更比对。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit with no historical version baseline, so cross-version change comparison is not possible.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未发现禁用安全能力或环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no wording was found that disables security capabilities or downgrades through environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件在审批事件上注册了自动放行监听器，但这是其无头运行模式的明确设计（README 与配置说明一致），并非通过置顶监听截断审批链的隐蔽行为。
evidence.en: The plugin registers an auto-approve listener on approval events, but this is an explicit design of its headless run mode (consistent between the README and the configuration description), not a covert behavior that truncates the approval chain by placing the listener at the top.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比对清单声明是否突变，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no version baseline, so it is not possible to compare whether the manifest declarations changed abruptly; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，未发现针对其他插件的服务注入或禁用行为。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configurations, and no service injection or disabling behavior targeting other plugins was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动网络服务或监听端口：未发现 Web 服务或端口监听代码，运行时只通过标准输入输出与父进程通信，不暴露本机无认证接口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a network service or listens on a port: no web service or port-listening code was found. At runtime it only communicates with the parent process over standard input/output and does not expose a local unauthenticated interface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了会话恢复逻辑：恢复已有会话时会核对工作目录是否一致，不一致则拒绝恢复，属良好的运行约束。
checked_items.en: Checked the session recovery logic: when resuming an existing session, the plugin verifies that the working directory matches; if it does not, recovery is refused. This is a sound runtime constraint.

checked_items.zh: 本维度基于静态分析结论，未做动态沙箱运行验证。
checked_items.en: This dimension is based on static analysis conclusions; no dynamic sandbox runtime verification was performed.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何网络服务、不监听端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 暴露面；宿主自身的无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no network services and listens on no ports, so there is no local unauthenticated RPC exposure surface; the host's own unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk and is unrelated to this plugin.

summary.zh: 核对插件元数据与身份：包声明为 dsh 插件并携带挂载配置，名称与任务卡一致，未发现品牌仿冒信号。
summary.en: Verified plugin metadata and identity: the package declares itself a dsh plugin with a patch config, and the name matches the task card. No brand impersonation signals were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部源码与配置：命中一处可执行配置表达式（DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51），经核查为良性路径取值；未发现危险函数调用、硬编码凭据或其他恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan of all source code and configuration: one executable configuration expression (DSH-P01 / DG-R3-51) was hit, but upon review it is a benign path value lookup; no dangerous function calls, hardcoded credentials, or other malicious patterns were found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无网络外发代码。
summary.en: Behavior surface analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, and no outbound network code.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：系统提示词与说明文档未发现注入或诱导措辞，插件未注册对外工具。
summary.en: AI metadata review: the system prompt and documentation show no injection or inducing wording, and the plugin registers no external tools.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证：上下文未提供动态运行产物。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed: the context did not provide dynamic runtime artifacts.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用：上下文未提供运行产物，未做动态验证。能力声明（联网、子进程、文件读写、面向模型）依据代码与文档推断，插件清单未显式声明能力字段。docs/images/multica-dsh-runtime.png 为二进制图片未做内容审查；pnpm-lock.yaml 为锁文件，仅核对了依赖清单未逐行通读。审批自动放行与任务令牌透传为插件明示的设计行为，已在相应维度检测痕迹中记录。兼容性状态为静态推断，未经动态验证。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not enabled: the context provided no runtime artifacts, so dynamic verification was not performed. Capability declarations (network access, subprocesses, file read/write, model-facing) were inferred from code and documentation; the plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields. docs/images/multica-dsh-runtime.png is a binary image and was not content-reviewed; pnpm-lock.yaml is a lockfile and only the dependency list was checked, not read line by line. Auto-approval and task-token passthrough are plugin-design-declared behaviors and have been recorded in the corresponding dimension detection traces. Compatibility status is a static inference and was not dynamically verified.
